name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for stucco texture matching services?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for stucco texture matching services?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a contractor for stucco texture matching, look for experience specifically in stucco repair and matching, as it's a specialized skill. Request to see a portfolio of their previous texture matching projects to assess the quality of their work. Ensure they are licensed and insured, and ask for references. A reputable contractor will also provide a detailed estimate and explain their process for achieving a seamless match, including color and texture considerations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for contractors with specific stucco matching experience, a portfolio of past work, licensing, insurance, and clear explanations of their process.
